# Rare Coloured Baseball Bat Farming Guide

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Sep 25, 2021
- 3 min read

Updated: Feb 12, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d3db4640f4fc4ae3a7ab329e663e58a4~mv2.png)

There are three rare coloured baseball bats in Fallout 76.

**Pink**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4b4d399c82814fcbbaafae86f21f49ac~mv2.jpg)

**Yellow**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9d463c89933c46c1b53b55bc517c5780~mv2.jpg)

**Indigo**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4187290215d7424f863c0ef6a3da1eda~mv2.jpg)

Coloured baseball bats will always be modded when they spawn/drop ie bladed, spiked etc

Coloured baseball bats are tradeable and can be made legendary using legendary crafting.

They can not be scrapped to unlock the paints/colours and can only be found using the below methods.

The methods listed below are in order of the most efficient to the least efficient.

**Method 1)**

US Government Supply Drops

Holotapes can be found on enemies, more so ghouls, and in in-world containers

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1a088f44f05d4c639ffeaf15fc9fdb95~mv2.jpg)

Load the holotape into the terminal found in Relay Towers on the map and follow the prompts.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e0361379ef104fe09573b1d1ee17cb83~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_fc1ba63a79da4e9598888c36b40e431d~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4d83465218b54edaa5ab4d825b7e0975~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c495313953a144208ddf5ecd5a1af014~mv2.jpg)

Relay Tower Locations:

Relay Tower EM-B1-27

The Forest near Vault Tech Agricultural Research Centre

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4b9167519ea04c509eb63cda8bf745bb~mv2.jpg)

Relay Tower HG-B7-09

The Ash Heap near AVR Medical Centre

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d62e1e59fc2049dd9e128c49b36f88ac~mv2.jpg)

Relay Tower DP-B5-21

Savage Divide near Uncanny Caverns

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c128adf302a54b4bb15869ed3cc4e26e~mv2.jpg)

Relay Tower EL-B1-02

Savage Divide near Johnson's Acre

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_477b1b3700304e68a534aaa03469d39c~mv2.jpg)

Relay Tower HN-B1-12

The Forest near Horizon's rest and Greg's Mining Supplies

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_fd39ca47e94d4a5aba2ba56c197933d1~mv2.jpg)

Relay Tower LW-B1-22

Savage Divide near Son's of Dane compound (One Violent Night)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_53f97d279607481a89d5d29739ae4538~mv2.jpg)

- These may not drop max level. Generally higher level regions will drop higher level bats.
- If anyone else but yourself and your teammates open the Government Aid Drop, they will become wanted.
- Your character can hold a max of 255 holotapes at a time however if you purchase additional US Government Supply holotapes from a player vendor for 1c+ then it will overwrite this number and allow you to carry more.
- US Government Supply Drops can bug out after the second or third round on the same server and they will stop dropping. Generally server hop or leave the server and come back after the second round of relay towers.

**Method 2)**

Collision Course

Fast travel to Morgantown Airport and run through the gates at the very end of the tarmac to activate the event then follow the event prompts.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4dbd482140eb431c8b9857859699d77a~mv2.jpg)

- Note leaving and coming back to the server will not refresh what has spawned in the supply crate.
- You can loot supply crates even if you weren’t in the event. It is worth swinging by this location on public servers in case someone has already done the event.

**Method 3)**

Supply Drops at random spawn locations

(Not to be confused with US Government Supply Drops.)

These will show up on the top right hand side of your screen as “Get the supply drop” when you go near a random encounter location. Follow the map marker and look for the red smoke.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9967b013ed3641b4a60eeb8915fa35fd~mv2.jpg)

**Method 4)**

Vendor Bots and Lite Allys

Raider Vendor Bots inventory at

- Sutton Train Station
- Sunnytop Train Station
- Pleasant Valley Train Station
- Pleasant Valley Ski Resort
- R&G Train Station

Sunny Robots at Foundation

__Cap'n Kidd__ bot at The Whitesprings Resort

__Daphne__ Lite Ally

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5c16a7bc97854358a689cc8f86ca48a8~mv2.jpg)

- Note these may not be max level

**Method 5)**

Crowned Humanoid Enemies (enemies that have a crown next to their name) that use weapons such as

- Super Mutants
- Blood Eagles
- Mole Miners
- Scorched
- Raiders

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_dd108d67a18d43b8894725301c9f2627~mv2.jpg)

These will show in their inventory as modded baseball bats i.e. “spiked baseball bat” or “bladed baseball bat”. It will not always show the colour in the preview screen so it is advised to “Inspect” the item and check the colour.

**Method 6)**

Event Rewards

There is a small chance that you can have a rare coloured baseball bat drop as an event reward.

**Method 7)**

World Spawns

This is not an efficient way to farm coloured baseball bats.

Found baseball bats have a:

- 27.27% chance of being the natural material
- 12.12% chance to be cedar, oak, or mahogany,
- 6.06% chance to be black, blue, grey, or red, and a
- 2% chance to be All-Star, indigo, pink, or yellow.

Instead, cross reference a few locations from the list with locations on the map that you visit often. (For example Grafton for Operation Tidy or Vault 94 for Daily Ops) and then when you are in that location, stick your head over and check the baseball bat spawns.

If the baseball bat is not the colour you want, then don’t pick it up. If it spawns as a coloured baseball bat then you will see the colour without needing to pick it up.

Locations of world spawn baseball bats can be found __here__.
